### Compatibility

Mirrors renderLabelCell: label/text/value precedence, description/subtitle/sublabel/supporting precedence, truncate defaults the limit to 40, and maxLength accepts a number or numeric string. Truncation uses the HTML three-dot suffix. Authored children replace the entire body. field binds label and descriptionField binds description; maxLengthParameter is consumed without a runtime value.
